text:
Type: tall narrow round pedestal table
Use: holding a plant, lamp or drinks, displaying small things; living room, bathroom, entryway, bedroom
Style: classic, retro, contemporary
Materials: white powder-coated steel frame, tempered glass top and shelves
Colors: white, clear frosted glass
Shape: small round top with a raised rim, two round shelves below, slim vertical rods, splayed flared feet, tall and slender, light and open
Feel: delicate, tidy, airy, charming
Goes with: white or pastel walls, plants, light wood; bathrooms, cottage or Scandinavian living rooms

product.name: GUNNERN
product.description: The raised edge around the table top keeps things from sliding off.
